records.title: 10-K
records.text: Passenger revenue increased $2.8 billion, or 5.7%, in 2024 as compared to 2023, primarily due to a 6.8% increase in capacity as well as a 5.3% increase in passengers.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cargo revenue increased $248 million, or 16.6%, in 2024 as compared to 2023, primarily due to higher tonnage, partially offset by lower yields.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Regional capacity purchase costs increased $116 million, or 4.8%, in 2024 as compared to 2023, primarily due to an 8% increase in regional capacity as well as increases in contractual rates.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Aircraft fuel expense decreased $895 million, or 7.1%, in 2024 as compared to 2023, primarily due to a lower average price per gallon of fuel, partially offset by increased consumption from higher flight activity.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash flows provided by operating activities for 2024 were $2.5 billion higher than 2023 primarily due to an approximately $0.9 billion increase in operating income and an approximately $0.9 billion increase in advance ticket sales due to capacity growth as demand trends for air travel continued to accelerate.
